name: War Map
subtitle: Wardriving navigation for Feather
description: War Map — plan routes, follow turn-by-turn directions, and explore roads with a Feather/AltStore-compatible source.

apps.name: War Map
apps.subtitle: Wardriving navigation & live directions
apps.localizedDescription:
War Map helps you plan drives and follow routes in real time.

• Start from your location or any address
• Destination search with local suggestions
• Driving route line on the map
• Turn-by-turn banner with distance and ETA
• Optional voice guidance (off by default)
• Re-center button and collapsible search while navigating
• Settings for route color, vehicle icon, and route options

Requires location permission. Built for personal wardriving and road exploration.
apps.versionDescription: Navigation UI: route line, live directions, re-center, collapsible search, settings (voice off by default), semi-local autocomplete, and route preference toggles.

versions.localizedDescription: v0.3.0 — Live navigation: driving route overlay, turn-by-turn updates, Go/End flow, re-center, collapsible address bar, inline scrollable suggestions, and Settings (route color, vehicle icon, voice, New Road slider, highway/ferry/toll/cross-border toggles). Requires iOS 16+.
v0.2.0 — Driving route overlay with turn-by-turn guidance and voice prompts.
